name: Phison Electronics Corp.
blurb: Phison Electronics Corp. is a Taiwanese company that designs and manufactures NAND flash controller ICs and storage solutions. It is a leading global supplier of USB flash drive, SD memory card, eMMC, and SSD controllers. The company serves a wide range of applications including consumer electronics, industrial, and automotive markets.
recent: In the past 30 days, Phison Electronics has seen steady trading on the Taipei Exchange with no major news or earnings releases. The stock price has been relatively stable, reflecting the company's consistent performance in the NAND flash controller market.
